previous_statement: The scale table gives 0<=t_2<=W.e_s2, while lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger supplies W.e_s2<=min\{e_s2^0,e_2\} and the remaining fixed-witness inequalities required by lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension. Apply that result to the datum to obtain u_2:M_{|U|+1}->A_R as an extended D_2*t_2-isomorphism with its raw unit estimate; the Stage-2 producer clause of lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger records this same literal map as an extended D_*t_2-isomorphism satisfying ||u_2(I)-u_{A_R}||<=D_*t_2 and eligible for lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation.
new_statement: Do not separately apply lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension or infer its two fixed-witness inequalities. Instead instantiate the aggregate Stage-2 producer conclusion exported by lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger at t=t_2. Its producer hypotheses are satisfied by the Stage-2 call-envelope datum of node 1.1.3.1.1 together with 0<=t_2<=W.r_reset and target ambient defect epsilon_R<=t_2: the first scale bound is supplied by lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger, and epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon<=W.K2*epsilon=t_2 because lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger gives W.K2>=W.L. That aggregate conclusion directly furnishes the literal map u_2:M_{|U|+1}->A_R as an extended D_*t_2-isomorphism, with ||u_2(I)-u_{A_R}||<=D_*t_2 and eligibility for lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation.
